title: goal: Evolve AgentFlow into a governed factory
body:
**Kind:** goal

Source: `docs/designs/governed-factory.md` (milestone program).

## Job

When AgentFlow claims controls its code does not implement, cannot run work unattended and records nothing an outsider can verify, I want to evolve it into a governed factory that builds itself, so I can offer an implementation-and-services package backed by a working reference stack by month 6.

## Outcome

- The named reference stack works end to end and is in actual use, by the factory building itself and on the author's own repositories.
- Agents take GitHub issues, build in contained `sbx` sandboxes, are reviewed across model families, and merge L1 and L2 work under conditions GitHub enforces.
- Every documented claim is backed or retracted in the claims ledger, and the evidence a run leaves can be verified offline by a third party.
- Milestones week 0, M0, M1, M2, M2b, M3, M4 and M5 are each met, as stated in their own goals.

## Release intent

An npm `latest` release with provenance, a mock-GxP sample repository, an offline evidence verifier, a case study with measured numbers, a public claims ledger, technical documentation, manuals and the product website. L3 (agent merge of the factory's own controls) and the deferred items P-1 to P-3 are later goals and are not folded in.

## Split judgment

Each milestone is its own goal (`goals/gf-week-0` to `goals/gf-m5`), admitted by the author through its admission gate; this goal is not split further.
